ColdStorage.description_en:
Indicates whether tiered storage for hot and cold data can be enabled. Valid values:

true: Tiered storage can be enabled.

false: Tiered storage cannot be enabled
ColdStorage.description_zh:
是否支持开通冷热分层存储，取值说明：

true：支持开通。
false：不支持开通

Policy.description_en: The parameters of the tiered storage policy for hot and cold data
Policy.description_zh: 冷热分层存储策略的参数
Policy.example: [{ "currentValue":"0.1", "defaultValue":"0.1", "desc":"Ratio of free disk space. When the ratio exceeds the value of configuration parameter, ClickHouse start to move data to the cold storage", "name":"move_factor", "restart":true, "valueRange":"(0, 1]" },{ "currentValue":"true", "defaultValue":"true", "desc":"Disables merging of data parts on cold storage", "name":"prefer_not_to_merge", "restart":true, "valueRange":"true|false" }]

State.description_en:
The status of tiered storage for hot and cold data. Valid values:

CREATING: Tiered storage is being enabled.

DISABLE: Tiered storage is disabled.

ENABLE: Tiered storage is enabled
State.description_zh:
冷热分层存储的状态，取值说明：

CREATING：开通中。
DISABLE：未开通。
ENABLE：已开通

StorageUsage.description_en: The cold storage space used. Unit: GB
StorageUsage.description_zh: 冷数据存储使用空间，单位：GB
